tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Except as provided in subsection (b), the Secretary concerned may, in accordance with this section and other applicable law, lease or permit the use of Federal land for a shooting range.

tree.heading: Exception
tree.text: The Secretary concerned shall not lease or permit the use of Federal land for a shooting range within—

children.text: a component of the National Landscape Conservation System;
a component of the National Wilderness Preservation System;
designated as a wilderness study area;
a national monument, national volcanic monument, or national scenic area; or
a component of the National Wild and Scenic Rivers System (including areas designated for study for potential addition to the National Wild and Scenic Rivers System).
